thesis: Live institutional tape is distributing (dark-pool mega-tier buy_ratio 0.003, $10.4B sold at the 211.14 close [DP]; UW composite DIRECTIONAL_SHORT [INSIGHT]), but the underlying is elite and peer-cheap (rev +71%, EPS +110%, fwd PE 17, lowest P/E in its AI peer group, strong-buy $307 target [FUND]) which vetoes a directional short into a sector seeing durable inflow (Tech persistence 1/1, $11.6B [MACRO]). With dealers long gamma pinning 210-220 [STRUCT], a 1-point toss-up debate [DEBATE], and 4/4 desk agents NEUTRAL/RANGE [AGENT], this is a range-bound name with 210 as the single decisive level, not a directional trade.

primary.trigger: spot holding inside the positive-gamma band; best fill on a rip to 214-216 or dip to 207-208

aggressive.trigger: rejection at the 215-216 zero-gamma ceiling where calls were written and faded

fade.trigger: sustained loss of 210 negative-gamma trapdoor flips directional short; reclaim/hold 216 with call OI building flips long

invalidation.price: Sustained close below 210 invalidates the range to the downside (flip to 210/200 put spread); close above 220 on rising call OI invalidates to the upside (mean-reversion long).
invalidation.signal: Dark-pool mega-tier buy_ratio flipping >0.50 for 2 sessions (distribution->accumulation), OR 215-225 calls flipping from written to ask-side bought (net_ask_bid positive) [DP/OI].
invalidation.macro: UW market-regime leaving TRANSITIONAL for a clean RISK-ON/RISK-OFF, or Tech sector-flow persistence dropping below 1 (inflow stalling) [MACRO].

structures.note: Put on ONLY after a sustained loss of 210 (negative-gamma trapdoor); 7b fundamental VETO blocks an unconditional short. Strikes anchored to 210 gamma hinge + 200 put-build/negative-gamma level (not a max-pain figure; max pain was not computed this run).

Collects the dealer positive-gamma pin band 205-220; wings near the +-1sigma 20-DTE expected-move edges (191-231). Regime-prescribed ('iron condors in range'). VRP FAIR so no vol edge — a gamma-pin range bet, sized 1.0%.

catalysts.event: June monthly OPEX (OPEX/gamma pull to 195-200 neg-gamma/put-build; not max-pain)

key_risks: 210 is a single point of failure: break flips dealer gamma negative into a trend short
VRP FAIR — the iron condor has no vol edge, pure gamma-pin range bet
small backtest N=8 / 50% win-rate — effectively no measured signal edge
the $10.4B 'distribution' is largely one closing-cross block — may be index/rebalance, not informed selling
